reviews.comment: Great professor hard class. She is the sweetest and cares so much but the material and date base used for the class ruins it all ngl. Please be aware taking this course cause it will hurt you at the beginning so you are going to want to try to recover.
reviews.ratingTags: So many papers--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: AMAZING PROF. never met such a caring prof in my life. easy class if you just take notes and review the study guide for exams.
If you do your stuff on time, you cannot fail this class. Very nice and provides updates in group me and on canvas. Highly recommend her
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Lectures were fun and engaging, she has a great personality. The group project felt very open to interpretation and grading criteria wasn't clear, she didn't grade hard though and gave us a lot of freedom with the project. Writing assignments were frequent but fun. The lectures usually turned more into discussions. No textbooks.

Dr. Sreenivasan was really easy to reach through groupme and email. Definitely read the textbook and do the interactive assignments as they help tremendously for tests. Grade was based on 4 tests, linkedin assignments, and a few other things to balance everything. One of the better courses for the business minor imo! It's pretty interesting too
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great Prof. She can be disorganized but really cares about teaching the material and does a good job with it.

I didn't have a ton of interaction with Dr. Sreenivasan, as I did not struggle and it was asynchronous, but I can say that the course was well organized and not difficult. The textbook has interactive lessons, which are helpful for exams, and the essay summarizing what you learned at the end of every module serves as a good refresher before exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: You definitely have to put in some work by reading the textbook and completing interactive assignments, but the test questions are very straightforward and a fair test of knowledge rather than questions designed to be tricky. The interactive lessons and online assignments are not super complicated! Take Dr. Sreenivasan if you can!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: She was a caring, engaging, and enthusiastic professor. I'm grateful to have gotten to learn from her. By facilitating an open discussion, we were able to bounce all of the key points from the PowerPoint we were following through class thoughts and ideas in a fun and memorable way. She honestly made each class so fun and worth attending.

AMAZING PROF!! Take her if you are able to! Deeply cares for her students. Doesn't believe in tests. This has been the most applicable class to the real world I have ever taken. Lectures were always engaging and interesting. Great course and wonderful professor.

She is so amazing and she cares so much. She found out some of us were missing classes due to advisor error and talked to department heads to teach a class so we could graduate on time. Her class is easy, fun, and if you have any problems, TALK TO HER! She is invested in us, clearly and will do whatever she can to help.

Professor Sreenivasan is one of the best professors I've ever had! She's an amazing professor with clear guidelines as to how this class will be graded and what she expects of you. She has so much knowledge and used time wisely, and is also just a great person in general. You work on one project long semester and a simulation as your grade

Professor Akshaya is one of the funniest, most influential people I have had the pleasure of being taught by at Mays. She is so high energy and gives the best personal anecdotes that tie in perfectly with her engaging lectures. She made me truly excited for marketing, and even had me up and ready for her 8 ams. Definitely grateful for her class!

Professor Sreenivasan is very knowledgeable and does a great job of teaching course concepts. Throughout the course she shows her care for her students and is willing to help and give advice for her course as well as what students are dealing with personally. The assignments are applicable to people who are pursuing a career in social media/pr.

Professors Sreenivasan provided the best lecture videos for this 5 week online marketing course. Business minor courses are usually very difficult but Professor Sreenivansan made the lectures short and concise, providing a broad study guide to go off of and some terms you should know before the exam. The course is also more than just exams. 10/10

I took this class for my minor, and even though it is a tough course due to not knowing previous knowledge like most business majors it was great. The professor had great interesting lectures, had enough assignments to help boost grade, and was always active on group me.

Dr. Sreenivasan is very enthusiastic about what she is teaching.  Majority of your grade is based on four exams.  You need to read the textbook thoroughly and watch her lectures in order to do well in the class.  Dr. Sreenivasan is very kind and responds quickly if you ask her questions.  I highly recommend taking her class!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Love this lady, I wish I could have her for a full semester. The exams are all from the textbook, so you have to read. There is a chapter summary due for all her videos so you are forced to watch them. She is entertaining and the material is pretty relevant. Would 100% take with her in the summer rather than the other prof in semester.

Overall, this was a great Summer class! My only difficulty was working 8-5 M-F and having some assignments due at 5pm during the week. Lectures were a great overview of the material. Textbook is a must! She is a tough love professor and I wish I had her for longer during the normal semester. What you give is what you get in this class! Take her!

Professor Sreenivasan is the best! In summer 2022, she uploaded video lectures so everything is asynchronous. Keep up with the videos and you MUST read the textbook to do well. This class is an easy B but to get an A you need to put in work.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have had for the business minor!!! 100% need the book & need to thoroughly read the book to do well in the class. She is a great professor though and responds in a timely manner, asks and appreciates student feedback, and communicates all expectations on a regular basis.

This was a great class with interesting lectures. Make sure you read the textbook for exams!! The exams were NOT open book this summer, so you needed to be prepared. There were reviews provided that were helpful. There was a variety of ways to earn points other than exams such as lecture summaries, certifications, and extra credit.

Professor Sreenivasan is awesome! She is very passionate about her students and she wants you to get the most out of her class as possible! The simulation is fun but pretty time-consuming sometimes, so be prepared to put in work outside of class. Overall I highly recommended Sreenivasan for Social Media and PR Marketing!

Great professor. Class is great and not too hard with a lot of busy work. I will say, that you better pray that you get a good group because a good portion of your grade comes from the group project. I was blessed to have a super great team so everything turned out fine. Exams will be hard if you do not know the material but they are open book.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class was relatively straightforward. Lecture summaries, tests, and a group project. Tests were open note for the summer, not sure if that is always the case. Overall, the grading was fair and feedback was given if you did not make a perfect score. The professor is extremely nice and passionate about teaching.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing Professor. Gave good feedback on exams and projects. Also made it very clear what the requirements were and made it very easy to succeed in the course. Would take her again in a heartbeat.

Overall the class was fairly easy and the professor was great. The one thing that makes this class annoying is the grading. In her class, it is based on points, not a percentage. It's out of 300 points, an A is 281-300, B is 261-280, C is 241-260, etc. So to get an A the lowest score is 93.67, B is 87, and C is 80.33. Terrible way to grade tbh....
Awesome professor! Take her for MKTG 409, 10/10 recommend.

SO glad I took her for MKTG. Had heard this class was going to be so tough, but everyone in our class did incredibly well. Easy A, enough said. Learned so much because her teaching style is very approachable, low stress, and friendly. TAKE HER!!

Dr. Sreenivasan is exceptional, she cares about her students being successful in and out of the classroom. I believe she's one of the most enthusiastic and passionate profs I have had throughout my college career. She'll definitely help you to her full ability when needed. I would definitely recommend you taking her class if given the opportunity!

Akshaya is great! MKTG 345 was engaging, fun, and loaded with interesting content on Marketing, Social Media, and PR. She genuinely cares about seeing students succeeding and learning, and has been very helpful in helping me find opportunities post-grad. If you show interest and engage in class, she'll notice and keep you in mind in the future.

Dr. Akshaya is an amazing professor. She is so passionate about marketing and is so creative and that translates into her lectures. She cares so much about her students and is always willing to help. She is also honest and will give you great feedback that gives room for growth. It was so exciting to learn about the most current marketing efforts

any negative comments on here must've been the student's fault because she was nothing but understanding and caring the whole semester. No exams, but attendance is crucial because there are many in-class assignments. would take again!

Akshaya is an amazing professor. She explains everything so well, often using her personal experience to help us understand. Her feedback also helps us be better students not just in her class, but also in life in general.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: These negative comments don't do her or the class justice. It seems like recent reviews gauged this class as an easy A which is how no class should be viewed before taking it. Ask questions, be considerate of teachers who are also doing online school, and apply yourself. She's really hardworking who's passionate and caring. I'd take her again.

Dr. Sreenivasan does not understand what it means to be a student. She will try to communicate with you via Groupme for important class assignments, and she'll close her classes by assigning random group work that is due the following day. She also made assignments due over a break day this semester.

Akshaya is not a very consistent professor. Her grading is often contradictory to her teaching, which makes it very difficult to gauge her expectations. If you're in her class, get ready to be on your toes regarding assignments and expectations.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor requires attendance at the beginning of every class and inputs the grade immediately. She did too much during online school, requested extra lighting if your room was too dark during zoom. A 90 isn't considered an A in her class, which led to my final grades being different than I thought. She is NOT clear at all in her assignments!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Awesome marketing professor! Interesting lectures. She illustrates course concepts through fascinating examples and draws from her work experiences in marketing. There is a crisis simulation which is a good experience and also semester-long social media campaign group project.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: To make an A you must get a 93.5% in the class. I made a 93.2% and she gave me a B and ruined my perfect GPA. Very unclear about instructions. No tests. If you forget any detail on a weekly summary of watching class, she WILL take off points. Didn't learn anything from her, only guest speakers.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Akshaya was the best professor I had in Mays Business School. She challenges you, encourages you, and makes sure you leave each session more informed than when you came in. She is passionate about Marketing and cares deeply about your success. She also brings in a ton of representatives from companies to help you in your job hunt.

She grades relatively easy. But don't be fooled, her class is no walk in the park. Her vague instructions and poor time management skills will give you an ultimate train wreck you just want to be rid of. The class is a lot of work and you won't know what you're doing about 99% of the time (but don't worry your class won't either).

Great professor! Attendance is mandatory. no tests, but grades are on a semester long group project, so make sure you get a good group. directions are pretty unclear, but has really interesting lectures and learned a lot!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: My favorite professor I've ever had at A&M by far!! There are no exams, but grade is heavily based on the semester long group project. If you do not attend class, you will lose points so make sure you go! If you get the chance to take her class, DO IT! I've taken all three of her marketing classes and I've learned so much!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring
